## Report

### Tests/packages given longer timeouts

| Package | Change |
|---------|--------|
| **`@mdfn/collab`** | Added `LARGE_COLLAB_UPDATE_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000` on the >1 MiB `applyUpdate` test |
| **`@mdfn/server`** | Renamed `COARSE_RESYNC_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS` → `HEAVY_FIXTURE_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS`; applied to all 4 heavy tests (3 coarse-resync + 1 MiB `appendCollaborationUpdate`) |

**Sweep notes:** Other heavy mdfn tests (`@mdfn/testing` large-document, `@mdfn/core` 1M sidecar validation) already pass well under 10s locally and on GHA. No package-level `testTimeout` bump — per-test constants match the server pattern from #159.

**Both.** Replaced 1,025×1 KiB chunks with **4×256 KiB token-safe chunks** (still `update.byteLength > 1 MiB`; a single `"x".repeat(...)` fails `MDFN_TOKEN_TOO_LARGE`). Added the documented **30s** Vitest budget for GHA (~27s observed).
